provenance: Both exact releases fetched with forager --all-wheels. Fetched 0.5.5 matches the supplied hash. Artifacts and .forage.json remain in scratch/version-drift-pyimagedl.

decisive_diff.details: Client request headers, DuckDuckGo vqd parsing and URL construction, museum v1.1 API path, manual Google CAPTCHA waiting, and a second embedded search API key. No new install hooks or payloads. Same metadata mismatch also fires on 0.5.4 under the baseline rules, contrary to the queue prior-scan description.

execution_review: CLI/configured source -> search query -> site JSON/HTML parser -> ImageInfo -> GET image -> validate raster format -> local image file.
pickle.dump writes local search_results.pkl/download_results.pkl. No pickle deserialization in the package.
optionalimport wrappers load installed modules; no decoding/evaluation of remote program text.

DrissionPage system/browser-cache/download fallback obtains Chrome for Testing metadata, downloads/extracts its ZIP, sets execute bits, and passes the browser path to ChromiumPage. Cleanup is limited to cache/install directories.
The socket binds loopback port zero to select a local browser control port; no listener command dispatch.
Explicit cookies/proxies are passed to search and browser clients; no installed browser credential database acquisition.

Long Base64-looking strings are 64-character literal hexadecimal API keys. Facts contain no decoded executable layer; no Base64 decode or exec call is present. Baidu URL translation serves image URL normalization.
